summary: Lint cleanups plus visible UI changes: a light/dark mode toggle button at the top of the page, footer now 'GitHub · Twitter' links, SEO description reworded (with a typo 'queyring'), and the login card links to Turso instead of D1 when a Turso URL is configured; server changes are only lint (unused params, a semicolon).

statements.text: Nothing flagged (plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.)
statements.why: No login, payment, database or secret issue: server edits are lint-only and only a boolean (isTurso) reaches the browser, the Turso token stays server-side.

statements.text: • The agent changed app.vue: it now shows "GitHub" and "Twitter".
statements.why: app.vue footer now has separate GitHub and Twitter links (was 'Source code on GitHub'). Doesn't mention the new dark-mode toggle in the same file.

statements.text: • The agent changed components/LoginForm.vue: it now shows "Turso database".
statements.why: LoginForm.vue shows 'Turso database' (linking turso.tech) only when runtimeConfig.turso.url is set; otherwise it still says 'D1 database'. An owner on D1 would expect the login card to now say Turso.

statements.text: • The agent also changed .eslintrc.cjs, in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: .eslintrc.cjs only turns off the 'vue/max-attributes-per-line' lint rule; dev tooling, no effect on the app. Implies an undescribed change that matters.

statements.text: (Hidden: 3 files whose changes don't change what the code does (formatting, unused parameters), or lockfiles.)
statements.why: composables/session.ts (unused catch param), server/api/todos/stats.ts (unused event param), server/plugins/migrations.ts (semicolon): all no-ops.

misses.what: New light/dark mode toggle button shown at the top of every page (app.vue:27-29).
Page meta description reworded and contains a typo ('queyring').
